tool.name: Azure upload
tool.command:
$__tool_directory__/run_azure_upload.sh
## Input Files --fq-fw $section_input.fastq_1 --fq-fw-name $section_input.fastq_1.name --fq-rev $section_input.fastq_2 --fq-rev-name $section_input.fastq_1.name
## Sample info --sample-name "$section_input.sample_name" --species "$section_input.species" --isolation-date "$section_input.isolation_date"
## Uploader info --uploader-mail-address $__user_email__

param.name: isolation_date
param.label: Isolation date
param.help: Required format: DD-MM-YYYY, not enforcable by Galaxy. Required for clustering.

tool.help: This tool uploads Fastq files to Azure to be automatically analyzed and inserted into their corresponding NRC platform. Only users with the required permissions can successfully execute this tool.
